comments.body:
Thanks for fixing the missing tool handling on the REST path! I reviewed `174f94a` and ran 127 related tests, which passed. There are two gaps I'd like us to cover before merging:

1. **Please check the payload against the actual editor tools.** All 14 schemas from `SlideEditToolbox.native_schemas()` include `additionalProperties`, but the new REST payload puts them directly into `functionDeclarations[].parameters`. That field uses Gemini's restricted `Schema` type, which does not have `additionalProperties`; I confirmed this against the current v1beta discovery schema and an offline protobuf parser. The existing test's simplified schema misses this. Could you use `parametersJsonSchema` for full JSON schemas, or explicitly convert them into the supported format while preserving their meaning? [API reference](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#FunctionDeclaration)

2. **Please cover the complete tool round trip.** Using the existing `NativeToolProtocolAdapter`, I captured the second REST request after recording a tool call and its result. Its `contents` still contains only a single text part with `[USER]`, an empty `[ASSISTANT]`, and `[TOOL]` text. The previous `functionCall` and the matching `functionResponse` are missing. The new extractor also replaces the original call ID with `gemini-tool-call-N` and discards `thoughtSignature`. Gemini requires the original ID when returning a function result, and Gemini 3 requires the signature to be returned on the original call part. I realize the plaintext conversion predates this PR, but enabling native tool calls exposes this incomplete continuation path. [Function calling guide](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/function-calling?hl=en) / [signature requirements](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures)

Could you add tests using the real editor schemas and a two-request Gemini 3 tool flow, checking the second payload's call/result structure, original ID, and signature? The four additional offline protocol checks I ran currently fail; the real-schema check passes on the PR's base revision and fails on this head. No live Gemini or mirror API calls were made.

Happy to take another look once these are covered. Thanks!

Thanks for the detailed review — both gaps are real and are covered in the new commit on this branch:

1. Tool declarations on the REST path now go in `parametersJsonSchema` (full JSON schema, passed through unchanged) instead of `parameters`. The new test feeds the real `SlideEditToolbox.native_schemas()` (which include `additionalProperties`) and checks each declaration carries its schema verbatim and no `parameters` key.
2. When any message carries tool state, the REST path now builds structured `contents` instead of the flattened text prompt: assistant `tool_calls` become `functionCall` parts and `tool` messages become `functionResponse` parts. `_extract_rest_tool_calls` keeps the original `functionCall.id` and the part's `thoughtSignature`, and the signature goes back on the replayed call part. Calls Gemini returned without an id still get the `gemini-tool-call-N` placeholder, which is never sent back. Consecutive tool results are merged into one user turn.

A new test drives `NativeToolProtocolAdapter` through two requests (call with id + signature, then the tool result) and asserts the second payload's `contents` is `user` / `model` (functionCall + id + signature) / `user` (functionResponse + same id). Text-only conversations keep the previous plaintext payload. `pytest tests/test_google_provider_rest_base_url.py tests/test_google_default_model.py tests/test_google_sampling_params.py tests/test_slide_edit_agent_service.py tests/test_provider_think_filter_and_requests.py`: 131 passed. Against the previous commit the four new and updated REST assertions in `test_google_provider_rest_base_url.py` fail. Not run against a live Gemini mirror.

This change was prepared with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) and reviewed before submission.
